title: Onboarding Regression Garden: Biweekly Triage & Sprint Plan
body:
TL;DR
Biweekly snapshot of onboarding regressions for models queued Feb–Mar 2026. Overall token-level pass rate dipped 2.8pp vs last cycle (baseline run: 2026-03-07). Two emergent failure clusters (instruction-following truncation on long contexts; hallucinated slot filling on structured prompts) explain ~64% of observed failures. This doc proposes immediate mitigations, owners for the next 2 sprints, and targeted eval/telemetry improvements.

What this is and scope
- Purpose: a hands-on triage + sprint plan for onboarding regressions observed during the biweekly eval sweep. Not exhaustive; prioritized by user-impact and recurrence across promptsets.
- Coverage: 18 promptsets (customer-facing + internal), 12 candidate models (v0.9–v1.2 variants), production-like seq distribution (max 2048).
- Data sources: nightly eval pipeline outputs, signalboard alerts, trace logs, sampling of failed responses.

Key metrics (compare to previous sweep 2026-03-07)
- Macro pass rate (promptset-level): 91.2% -> 88.4% (delta -2.8pp)
- Mean instruction-F1 (structured tasks): 0.82 -> 0.78 (delta -0.04)
- Latency P95 for candidate model pool: 190ms -> 210ms (config change on backend routing noted)
- Regression density: 37% of promptsets saw >=1 new failure cluster

Top failure clusters (by volume + user impact)
1) Truncation on long-context instructions (32% of failures)
   - Symptom: model emits early end tokens or repeats short completions when prompt >900 tokens, especially with multi-turn instructions that require remembering earlier constraints.
   - Affected promptsets: long-form summarization, legal-extraction, multi-step planning.
   - Hypothesis: KV cache eviction/attention window misalignment after quantized layer swap (v1.1q). Also observed higher tokenization mismatch in preproc for some prompt variants.
2) Hallucinated structured slots (21% of failures)
   - Symptom: for table-fill and key/value extraction prompts, model invents non-existent values or misaligns column indices.
   - Affected promptsets: crm-data-extract, invoice-parser, product-catalog-mapper.
   - Hypothesis: decoder temperature/beam change in model-serving config + prompt template drift (templates lost guardrails).
3) Safety/over-censoring false positives (8% of failures)
   - Symptom: valid customer queries are blocked or rewritten to refusals after a filter update on 2026-03-10.
   - Action: roll back filter patch to canary and run synthetic safety suite.
4) Reranking instability (3% of failures)
   - Symptom: produced answers are correct but downstream reranker demotes them; mismatch between generation token score and reranker features.

Representative failing prompts (anonymized)
- Long-context: "Summarize the following 6-page contract keeping all definitions for Section II and cross-references to Annex A... [~1,200 tokens]" -> truncated summary missing Section II definitions.
- Invoice: "Extract invoice_total, tax_rate, vendor_tax_id from the OCR blob" -> vendor_tax_id = "N/A (assumed)" (invented) instead of blank.

Immediate actions (next 5 working days)
- ID: RGD-01 | Owner: Marco Alvarez | Action: Reproduce truncation locally across v1.0/v1.1/v1.1q with seq-growth harness; capture KV cache traces and token-level attention heatmap. Target: reproduce 90% of cases.
- ID: RGD-02 | Owner: Lina Chen | Action: Run prompt template linting against the promptset repo; reintroduce guardrails for structured tasks. Target: PR with fixes + test harness by 2026-03-26.
- ID: RGD-03 | Owner: Ethan Park | Action: Canary rollback of safety filter patch on canary subset and run synthetic safety + utility sweep. Target: decision and rollback by 2026-03-25.
- ID: RGD-04 | Owner: Priya Nair | Action: Add explicit null-token handling to invoice parsing evaluator; update metric to surface invented values. Target: deploy eval update by 2026-03-27.

Medium-term actions (2 sprints)
- Instrumentation: add per-request KV-cache eviction logs and a lightweight attention-profile metric to signalboard. Owner: Marco.
- Model policy: create model-variant compatibility matrix for quantized variants; block auto-rollouts where sequence distributions mismatch. Owner: Sofia.
- Reranker calibration: add margin-aware features for reranker and backtest on archived candidate set. Owner: Engineering Solutions.

Prioritization rationale
- Truncation impacts user-visible correctness for long documents -> high severity and high recurrence.
- Hallucinated slots directly damage downstream integrations and internal metrics (false positives cost higher support time).
- Safety rollback is low-risk and fast; prioritized to restore utility for blocked prompts.

Follow-ups & syncs
- Weekly check-in cadence: Monday triage stand (15m) until RGD-01 reproduced; then biweekly. Invite list: eng-applied-ml, serving-runtime, console-and-tooling.
- Required artifacts before next sweep: reproducible harness logs for RGD-01, PR for promptset fixes, eval-change diff.

Eval config notes (important for reproducibility)
- Seed schedule: deterministic RNG seeds per promptset (seed range 7200–7219).
- Sampling config: top-p 0.92 / temp 0.0 for structured tasks; top-p 0.95 / temp 0.7 for creative prompts.
- Comparison baseline: last stable run = model-pool v1.0 (unquantized) from 2026-03-07.

Instrumentation queries to add to signalboard
- "kv_eviction_count by model_variant over 24h"
- "prompt_template_version mismatch rate by promptset"
- "invented_slot_count per 10k prompts"

Notes and loose hypotheses (for engineering research)
- Quantization-induced attention drift is plausible but unlikely to explain slot hallucinations; investigate interplay with tokenizer changes and post-processing heuristics.
- Routing change that increased P95 could be indirectly exposing timing-sensitive bugs (timeouts leading to truncated outputs).

Appendix A: Sample debug checklist for reproducing truncation
1) Run failing prompt against v1.0/v1.1/v1.1q with identical sampling seeds.
2) Capture kv-cache length and eviction events after token >768.
3) Dump attention sparsity map and per-layer quant stats.
4) Compare tokenization between preproc artifact and eval harness (unicode normalization differences noted in past rolls).

Appendix B: Slack/PR pointers
- Slack thread: #applied-ml-regressions (see thread 2026-03-21 T11:30)
- PR for eval update (draft): github.com/redwood-inference/evals/pull/512

Decision log (short)
- 2026-03-22: safety filter patch temporarily reverted on canary for 10% traffic after synthetic suite passed (Ethan).
- 2026-03-23: promptset lint PR merged to staging; further template coverage work scheduled (Lina).

Open questions
- Is there a recent change in tokenizers across infra that matches regression onset? (SRE/infra check)
- Do we have enough archived reranker training data that matches post-quantized outputs for recalibration?

Next biweekly goals (deliverables by 2026-04-04)
- Definitive root cause for truncation (repro and trace).
- Patch or guardrail for structured-slot hallucination with updated eval metric.
- Signalboard panels for KV eviction and invented-slot rate.

If you want to dig in quickly
- Start with RGD-01 reproducer logs in the nightly artifacts bucket (linked in Confluence page).
- Ping leads on Slack if blocked: @sofia / @marco / @lina.

---
Document history: created 2026-03-21 by Sofia Ramirez; triage updates 2026-03-23 (Lina/Ethan); added follow-ups 2026-03-24 (Marco).
